item.title: Pakistani general says Iran diplomacy still alive, despite US blockade, failed talks
item.summary: The U.S. naval blockade on Iran may be leverage to resume diplomacy, says retired Pakistani general, as both sides were reportedly close to a deal.

item.title: ‘Gate of Tears’ at risk: Iran threatens major new global chokepoint if US moves on Hormuz
item.summary: Senior Middle East advisor warns Iran could use Houthi proxies to blockade the Bab al-Mandeb strait if the U.S. blocks the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: IDF uncovers Hezbollah weapons stash inside hospital in Lebanon
item.summary: Israel Defense Forces uncovered a weapons stash used by Hezbollah terrorists inside a hospital in Lebanon this weekend.

item.title: Pope Leo calls out 'delusion of omnipotence' fueling Iran war in vigil for peace at St. Peter's Basilica
item.summary: Pope Leo decries the "delusion of omnipotence" he says is driving the war in Iran, urging peace during a Saturday vigil at St. Peter's Basilica.

item.title: Iran's supreme leader severely disfigured by US strikes: report
item.summary: Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is severely disfigured after U.S.-Israel airstrikes on Tehran killed his father, according to a Reuters report citing anonymous sources.

item.title: Iran regime uses former Soviet republic to dodge sanctions, fund war machine: report
item.summary: Once a committed U.S. ally, Georgia has quietly aligned with Iran, raising concerns about IRGC influence and sanctions evasion, a new report claims.

item.title: Iran’s ‘Godfather of propaganda’ tactics resurface in war with US and Israel
item.summary: Experts say Iran uses civilians and children as human shields for propaganda purposes, caring nothing for the safety and fate of its own people.

item.title: Iran in crisis as US talks collapse, Mojtaba’s ‘mafia’ regime blocks Khamenei burial: analyst
item.summary: Analyst says Iran's delay in burying Supreme Leader Khamenei over 40 days after his killing reveals a deepening crisis inside the Islamic Republic.

item.title: Kim Jong Un oversees cruise missile launches from prized new North Korean warship
item.summary: State media claims Kim Jong Un watched cruise and anti-ship missile launches from North Korea's new warship Choe Hyon during Sunday's weapons tests.

item.title: Macron under fire over Iran, Hezbollah policy as Trump admin hosts Israel-Lebanon talks
item.summary: Macron faces intense criticism for demanding Lebanon's inclusion in the ceasefire while Israel accuses France of undermining its efforts against Iran and Hezbollah.
